name: Pet Care - Vet Hospital Simulator VR
summary:
Welcome to Pet Care – Vet Hospital Simulator VR, a fun and immersive veterinary simulation game in VR where you become a real pet doctor and run your own animal hospital!

Step inside your fully interactive VR vet clinic and care for adorable pets including dogs, cats, and more. Diagnose illnesses, treat injuries, perform checkups, and use realistic medical tools to help your furry patients feel better.

🐾 Become a Real Vet in VR

Experience hands-on pet treatment using interactive medical equipment. Exami
